finding: Higher-order multiple pregnancies are high-risk, associated with preterm delivery, maternal complications (especially anemia), and high perinatal mortality, emphasizing the importance of antenatal care and close monitoring.
mod_finding: Half of the women (11, 50%) were delivered by elective cesarean section and 7 (31.8%) by emergency cesarean section (C/S), while 4 (18.2%) had a spontaneous vaginal delivery.
